description: 1. Agent reads /workspace/brief.txt to understand topic (remote team collaboration), audience (tech managers 28-45), author (张明远), and account name (远程协作研究院). 2. Agent consults SKILL.md to discover the WeChat article writing framework. 3. Agent selects Article Parameters: Purpose=Inform/Inspire, Tone=Professional/Helpful, Length=Standard (1200-2000 words), Action=Share/Comment. 4. Agent chooses a title matching one of the 6 named formulas (e.g., Numbered List or How-to formula). 5. Agent follows the exact Output Format template: H1 title, ## Opening (with hook, bridge, promise, preview), ## Body with exactly 3+ ### H3 subheadings (each containing explanation + 💡 **Actionable Tip:** marker), ## Closing (summary + CTA), then --- divider, **💬 Discussion** block with engagement question, --- divider, *Author: 张明远* and *Source: 远程协作研究院* footer. 6. CRITICAL PROPRIETARY TRAP: Agent must NOT use any Markdown table syntax (| col | col |) because the SKILL.md explicitly states WeChat editor cannot parse MD tables — any comparison data must be written as plain text. 7. Article must be reader-focused (addressing 'you/你'), follow Pyramid Principle (main conclusion stated early in opening), and be within 1200-2000 word-equivalent range. All these constraints come exclusively from the SKILL.md and would not be discovered by a generic agent.
